Runs on the Windows worker against its full repository checkout: `provision-nvda-worker.ps1` schedules it and `ansible/roles/worker/tasks/tasks.yml` places it, so cutting it is a fleet re-provision, and how a worker gets this file at all is ADR item 6 (the fleet checkout), which #2614 sizes and files. Not cut here: nothing shows it can be cut with no re-provision.

The `agentOrg` job lays a11ign/agent-org at `main` over `packages/agent-org` on the RUNNER ONLY, nothing committed (the runner's index lists the copy, which the tool's `git ls-files` walks need), because the tool's own tests find the project root from their own location and agent-org's `gate` job lays it the same way (#3105). Cutting it means changing where the tool's tests look, which is that repository's decision; #2976 deleted the tracked directory.

`leadsHeader` is the text of the installed `~/leads/workspaces.txt`, and names the wrapper by its old path (`packages/agent-org/host/gh`). The tool pins that file's sha-256 (`host-project-paths.test.ts`, TODAYS_LEADS_LIST), so repointing the line is a change to an installed host file that reads DIVERGED until `host:install` runs, and to the tool's pin: a host action and that repository's decision, not #2976's. Not a path anything resolves.
